entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard on I.A. No. 187/2024 second application filed u/s. 389 of Cr.P.C. for suspension of jail sentence on behalf of appellant Akash @
Akku.

The appellant stands convicted under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(N) and 366 of IPC and has been sentenced to undergo 20 years RI, 10 years RI and 7 years RI with fine of Rs. 1,000/-, Rs. 1,000/-
and Rs. 500/- with default stipulation.
As per prosecution story, the prosecutrix eloped with the appellant on 6.6.2019, thereafter she was recovered on 11.6.2019.
She was medically examined and as per DNA report commission of rape has been established.
The court has found that she was 14 years of age on the basis of date of birth recorded in the scholar register.
Parents of prosecutrix have turned hostile.
Prosecutrix has also not supported the case of prosecution.
So far as the entry of date of birth in scholar register is concerned, that was recorded only on the basis of oral declaration by her parents and no other documentary evidence was produced.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the prosecution has failed to prove the age of prosecutrix below 16 years, therefore, conviction under section 376(3) IPC is bad in law in which sentence of 20 years has been awarded.
The appellant has no criminal past.
In this appeal, the prosecutrix has given an affidavit to the effect that she has no objection if sentence is suspended and bail is granted to appellant.
The appeal is of the year 2021 and there is no likelihood of its final hearing in near future.
He, therefore, prays for suspension of jail sentence and release him on bail.
On the other hand, learned Govt. Advocate opposes the prayer and prays for rejection of the application.
Counsel for objector submits that objector has no objection if sentence is suspended and bail is granted to appellant.

sentences.text: Considering the aforesaid, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application for suspension of sentence (I.A. No 187/2024) is allowed and it stands closed.

It is directed that subject to deposit of the fine amount, if not already deposited with the trial Court and on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.40,000/- (Rupees Forty Thousand Only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court, the execution of remaining custodial part of sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended, till final disposal of this appeal.
The appellant after being enlarged on bail shall mark his presence before the Registry of this Court on 22.4.2024 and on all such subsequent dates, which are fixed in this behalf.
IA Nos. 187/2024, 188/2024 and 862/2024 stand disposed off.
(VIVEK RUSIA)
